selection: GT diagnostic: maximize scene GT 3D AJ, tie lower MTE, then earlier step. All metrics use the same selected step. Primary result: sealed pseudo-loss rule with its eligibility guard.
aggregation: Unweighted mean of scene scores within each dataset; first occurrence of each point ID; exclude query frame. AJ stored as fraction, MTE in metres.

cohorts.original: Original fixed point set, CoTracker3 online teacher replacement, fixed initialization.
cohorts.mixed: GT-conditioned quality/diversity point set, CoTracker3 online teacher and re-triangulated initialization. Not a point-selection-only ablation.
